violations.text: Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026

Reduced oxygen packaged Brazino was observed for retail sale. Per interview of staff, Brazino is vaccum packaged on site. Establishment is not approved for this process. ROP fish was voluntarily disposed of. Establishment to cease process. Vaccum packaging machine and materials were removed from premises during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Cooked octopus was observed in prep unit at 80 degrees Fahrenheit. Per interview of staff, octopus was recently cooked. Cooked octopus was placed into walk-in cooler to continue cooling process. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026

Thermometers are lacking in the refrigeration unit(s). Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2025

The doors to the outside, located at the entrance, are not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2025
The door to the restroom is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2025
